description: Detection rules for Australian TFN, French INSEE/NIR, and Spanish DNI/NIE.

rules.name: Australian Tax File Number (TFN)
rules.description: Matches 8 or 9-digit Australian Tax File Numbers

rules.name: French National Identification (INSEE / NIR)
rules.description: Matches 13 or 15-digit French social security numbers (NIR/INSEE)

rules.name: Spanish DNI / NIE National Identity Number
rules.description: Matches Spanish Documento Nacional de Identidad (DNI) and Foreigner NIE identifiers
